prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a glossy black pudding blob resting on the ground, a rounded wobbly mound with bright white shine highlights and a dark blue-grey rim light, exactly three small round yellow eyes on its front surface, no mouth; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: only three small yellow eyes on the glossy black surface, no mouth.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, the whole mass lunging and stretching forward toward the heroes in one soft wave, the three yellow eyes wide, staying well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, flattened and squashed down low, rippling, the three yellow eyes squeezed half shut, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Squash and stretch the whole mass: stretch it toward the heroes or flatten and bulge it, always one soft mass resting on the ground, staying well inside its own cell; the same three eyes in every cell. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, a single soft mass resting on the ground line, a clear dark outline. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a mouth, teeth, bones inside, green colour, grey colour, a fourth eye, arms, drips falling off, a puddle.
